issues.description: The method Course.addRating(stars:) has conflicting visibility across artifacts. The problem statement (and the template extension) specify and expect a normal instance method that can be called from other files (the exercise instructs implementing addRating and Client.swift calls swiftCourse.addRating). In the solution implementation (Sources/DeveloperLib/Course.swift) the method is declared private (private func addRating(stars: Int)). Declaring it private restricts access to the defining source file and will cause a compilation error when Client.swift (a different file) invokes swiftCourse.addRating, blocking the intended usage and preventing the project from building.
issues.suggestedFix: Make Course.addRating(stars:) accessible to other files by removing the private modifier. Replace 'private func addRating(stars: Int)' with 'func addRating(stars: Int)' (internal) or 'public func addRating(stars: Int)' if cross-module access is required. This preserves the intended API for Client.swift and allows the project to compile.
